summary: Avatar, KpiCard, TextField and Card all switched to their skeleton state by one shared loading flag.
use: Loading states where real components keep their exact size and show a placeholder until data arrives.
spec: `let loading = $state(true)` passed as `skeleton={loading}` to four components
`<Avatar alt="Ana Lima" size="xl" skeleton={loading} />` and `<KpiCard title="Revenue" value="R$ 12.400" trend={3.2} skeleton={loading} />`
`<TextField label="Email" description="We never share it" skeleton={loading} />`
`<Card title="Overview" skeleton={loading}>` with one paragraph of content
